1.note: the chain starts at an unnamed 'genetic variant' (TNFSF13 variants, per the mechanism); the title names the protein. Aspect risk: the mechanism has IgA overproduction cause immune complex deposition, i.e. the disease itself. The chain ends at IgA production and never reaches IgA nephropathy, hence the second claim

2.note: the title says 'CFH deficiency permits complement activation'; the chain starts at variants that lower CFH, so the claim's subject is the variant and its sign is pos (CFH's own sign would be neg). Aspect severity: the mechanism says the inflammation 'exacerbates IgA-mediated glomerular injury'. The chain ends at renal inflammation, hence the second claim

3.note: the chain starts at the DEFA4 protein; the mechanism also names DEFA4 variants that raise its expression, but no chain step carries them. Aspect severity: 'exacerbates glomerular damage', 'worsening IgA-mediated injury'. The chain ends at glomerular damage, hence the second claim

findings.detail: the run cites nothing at all: every chain step has empty evidence, every hypothesis has empty supporting_evidence and contradicting_evidence, and sources.json is empty, although eleven specialists (literature, gwas, uniprot, ...) were available
the budget asks for at least 2 evidence items and 2 sources per hypothesis; all three hypotheses have zero, yet the run was emitted with abstention null rather than abstaining or being rejected
confidence 'medium' with support 'speculative' and not one citation
confidence 'medium' with support 'speculative' and not one citation
no node in any chain carries a CURIE or grounding_evidence; all were grounded here from the labels

the subject of 1.1 and of 2.1 is the bare label 'genetic variant' (declared kind 'protein'), naming no gene, allele or rsID; the genes come only from the mechanism text, and the identical label denotes two different nodes (TNFSF13 variants, CFH variants), which a label-level merge would join
'genetic variant' is declared kind 'protein'

the last step of every chain has polarity 'unknown' although the run's own mechanism states the direction (IgA production enhanced, complement activation causing inflammation, degranulation damaging glomeruli); with no citation to supply it, every chain breaks at its final link

3.1 ends at 'neutrophil recruitment' (GO:1990266 neutrophil migration), 3.2 starts at 'neutrophil degranulation' (GO:0043312); different processes, so the chain has no link from DEFA4 to degranulation
the chain ends at 'IgA production'; immune complex formation and mesangial deposition, which the mechanism says follow, are not steps, so it never reaches IgA nephropathy
the chain ends at 'renal inflammation'; the mechanism's 'exacerbates IgA-mediated glomerular injury' is not a step, so it never reaches IgA nephropathy
the chain ends at 'glomerular damage' and never reaches IgA nephropathy
the mechanism opens with 'DEFA4 genetic variants increase DEFA4 expression', but the chain starts at the DEFA4 protein with no variant step, unlike hypotheses 1 and 2

hypothesis 1's knockout 'should reduce mesangial IgA deposition' is labelled expected 'positive', while hypothesis 3's knockout that should reduce neutrophil infiltration is labelled 'negative'; the expected field means different things in the same run

hypothesis 1's readout 'mesangial IgA deposition' is downstream of its chain's end (IgA production), and hypothesis 2's 'glomerular complement C3 deposition' is a deposit, not the chain's complement activation; hypothesis 3's test does read out chain nodes (neutrophil infiltration is 3.1's recruitment, and its description adds glomerular damage, 3.2's object) but not neutrophil degranulation, the node its chain fails to reach

the title says 'CFH deficiency' (loss of CFH causes the disease, so neg by the sign rule) but the chain starts at variants that lower CFH (so the subject rule picks the variant, whose sign is pos); the guide does not say which wins, and following both literally gives an incoherent variant →− claim
four of the seven input genes (ITGAX, CARD9, OR4X1, ZNF174) get no hypothesis

the corpus UniProt record for CFH (P08603) says it 'Acts as a soluble inhibitor of complement' that 'prevents complement activation', which states step 2.2, but the run, with a uniprot specialist available, cited it nowhere; not attached here because the run did not cite it
neither claim (TNFSF13 variants to IgA nephropathy risk, to IgA production) has a route: the chain stops at B cell activation because 1.3 has no sign
neither claim (CFH variants to IgA nephropathy severity, to nephritis) has a route: the chain stops at complement activation because 2.3 has no sign
neither claim (DEFA4 to IgA nephropathy severity, to glomerular damage) has a route: the chain stops at neutrophil migration, as 3.1 and 3.2 do not connect and 3.2 has no sign

GO has no IgA production process (only immunoglobulin production GO:0002377 and isotype switching to IgA isotypes GO:0048290), so 'IgA production' is immunoglobulin production refined to IgA plasma cells (CL:0000987, 'a fully differentiated plasma cell that secretes IgA'), the same node the sibling single-agent IgA nephropathy run uses
BLN:TNFSF13-variants and BLN:CFH-variants: classes of unspecified variants, because the run names no allele; they are nodes only within this run
'neutrophil recruitment' has no GO term or synonym; grounded to the broader neutrophil migration (GO:1990266) rather than neutrophil chemotaxis or extravasation

'glomerular damage' has no exact term; grounded to Abnormal renal glomerulus morphology (HP:0000095), since the mechanism speaks of damaged glomerular structures, rather than Glomerulopathy (HP:0100820), a disease class

a step's direction may come only from a cited text, while a claim's sign comes from the title or mechanism; here the mechanism states the direction of all three unknown-polarity steps, so the claims are signed but the chains cannot be, and there is no way to record 'direction stated by the run, unsupported'
the falsification experiments (perturbation, readout, expected direction) and the run's unexplained genes have no place in curated.json other than findings
